referenceDescription: SNACKET MixoBar EV on a white background, rear 3/4 view slightly elevated, both lift-up service doors raised open — a larger LEFT door and a smaller RIGHT door, showing 9 wood-handled faucet taps mounted inside the service bay

left_door_interior.label: Left lift-up door underside (larger panel)
left_door_interior.fragment: The larger LEFT lift-up service door is raised open; its flat underside panel (light wood-plank texture) shows a circular SNACKET logo. Replace that logo with the IMAGE B logo, large and centered on the panel, following the panel's tilt and perspective. Keep the wood texture and door hinges/gas struts intact.

right_door_interior.label: Right lift-up door underside (smaller panel)
right_door_interior.fragment: The smaller RIGHT lift-up service door is raised open, to the right of the left door; its flat underside panel (same light wood-plank texture) shows a circular SNACKET logo. Replace that logo with the IMAGE B logo, sized to fit this smaller panel, following the panel's tilt and perspective. Keep the wood texture and door hardware intact.

driver_cab_panel.label: Driver cab door panel
driver_cab_panel.fragment: On the driver-side cab door, near the front of the vehicle, there is a circular SNACKET logo with the text "MIXO BAR" printed directly below it. Replace ONLY the circular logo above the text with the IMAGE B logo, at the same size and position, respecting the door surface curvature and lighting. Do NOT alter, remove, or cover the "MIXO BAR" text beneath it — that identifies the vehicle model, not the brand, and must stay exactly as-is.
